dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: Ah, Piramida, I know that name... *sigh* I've been getting lost left and right ever since I came to Nod-Krai... But I made it to Nod-Krai this time, didn't I? That's an improvement, at least.

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: In good news, there seems to be no shortage of things here that can serve as my research topics.

dialogues.speaker: Dzenana
dialogues.text: And since we're already here, might as well stick around for a while and stock up on supplies before I head over to Nasha Town!
